data.body: INTERMEDIATE investigation complete. ROOT_CAUSE: merge-to-main-pr.sh:3033 fallback pins 'gh pr list --base ${_DEFAULT_BRANCH:-main}'; two-channel PR1 targets a staged-* base, so the query returns empty -> exit 1 at :3046, stranding mergeable PR. Second confirmed root cause: pr_number is never persisted on the resume-found-existing-PR path (_state_write_pr_meta is only called inside _phase_merge :1212, which resume skips), so the broken fallback is always reached. H1-H5 confirmed empirically; NOT fixed on origin/main (buggy line present at origin/main:3033; HEAD==origin/main for this file). Fix: PRIMARY drop --base (base-agnostic query preferring non-draft, mirroring resume-discovery :2936); SECONDARY persist pr_number when resume discovers an open PR. Risk: low (1 open PR per head; isDraft==false + .[0] deterministic). testing_mode=RED; no test covers the staged-base polling fallback.
